offering_description.value: Provides executive search, leadership consulting, assessment and talent advisory services to organizations worldwide. Clients are mainly large companies, nonprofits and public-sector bodies that need to recruit, develop and retain senior leaders. Services are delivered by consultants on fee-based engagements, supported by proprietary assessment tools and a digital talent platform.

primary_products.value: assessment tools; leadership development content; talent management software

primary_services.value: executive search; leadership consulting; succession planning; compensation consulting; outplacement; organizational consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: large corporations, financial institutions, private equity firms, nonprofits; B2G: government agencies and public institutions

end_markets.value: financial services; technology; healthcare; consumer goods; industrials

revenue_model.value: project or contract: retained executive search fees paid by clients for filling senior roles; service fees: consulting, assessment and leadership development engagements; subscription: access to digital assessment and talent platforms
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells consulting and search services to employers, sourcing and advising on executive talent; software / platform: offers digital talent and assessment platforms to corporate clients

geography_served.value: global: offices across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: executive search, leadership consulting, assessment, succession and compensation consulting, all sold to the same corporate clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: consultants sell engagements directly to corporate and public-sector clients; online: digital assessment and talent platform used by clients and candidates

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR and employment and anti-discrimination laws that apply to recruiting and assessments
